drivers.name: Commercial aftermarket growth
drivers.last_report: Q3 commercial aftermarket revenue grew 17%; management said growth remained strong.
drivers.guidance: FY2026 commercial aftermarket revenue growth in low double-digit percentage range.

drivers.name: Commercial OEM growth
drivers.last_report: Q3 commercial OEM grew nicely as aircraft OEMs continue to increase build rates.
drivers.guidance: FY2026 commercial OEM revenue growth in mid-teens percentage range.

drivers.name: Defense revenue and backlog
drivers.last_report: Q3 Defense had another quarter of consistent growth and built sizable backlog.
drivers.guidance: FY2026 defense revenue growth high single-digit to low double-digit percentage range.

drivers.name: EBITDA As Defined margin
drivers.last_report: Q3 EBITDA As Defined margin 52.8% vs 54.4%; base margins expanded excluding acquisition dilution.
drivers.guidance: FY2026 EBITDA As Defined $5,490-$5,550M, margin guide approximately 52.5%.

drivers.name: Acquisition and capital deployment
drivers.last_report: Q3 repurchased $1.0B; completed JPE/Victor Sierra; post-quarter P&I deal ~$1.07B; higher interest expense.
drivers.guidance: FY2026 guidance excludes P&I contribution; no separate Q4 guidance.

card.guidance: FY2026: net sales $10,470-$10,550M; net income $2,102-$2,150M; EPS $35.38-$36.21; EBITDA As Defined $5,490-$5,550M (~52.5% margin); adjusted EPS $40.62-$41.46. Excludes pending P&I acquisition. Market growth: commercial OEM mid-teens, commercial aftermarket low double-digit, defense high-single to low-double-digit.
kill_conditions: Commercial aftermarket growth reported below low double digits or decelerating from Q3's 17%.
Commercial OEM growth below mid-teens or defense growth below high single digits.
FY2026 EBITDA As Defined margin guided below ~52.5% or guidance cut on acquisition dilution/interest costs.
